review.rationale: The Decision strictly binds the qualifying Recommendation (Option A, SHA-256 verified), preserves both R1 and v0.1 review failures as immutable evidence, and limits mutation to exactly two fields: the common schema $id alignment and its manifest bytes/SHA-256 entry. The local-only Registry contract explicitly forbids remote retrieval and deprecated resolvers, and the R2 validation scope covers all 28 files, duplicate key rejection, 14 draft-2020-12 schemas, candidate/template instances, and positive/negative samples. The commit gate is fail-closed, scoped to the package directory, and contingent on complete pass. All non-authorizations (no public fetch, credential read, model request, technical reuse, runtime, agent, entity, permission, PR, merge, release, deployment, customer adoption, commercial offering, certification, or production readiness) are explicitly preserved. Authority boundaries remain intact, and the decision review contract enforces exactly one qwen3.7-max direct JSON request with a qualifying threshold of APPROVE, confidence >= 0.9, all booleans true, and zero blockers/corrections.
